request.spec:
Each sheet has a "today" date, shown on the screen and changeable there. It starts as the real
date. Every decision in the app that depends on the date, and every default date, uses the
sheet's today and never the real clock.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Each sheet has a "today" date, shown on the screen and changeable there. It starts as the real
date. Every decision in the app that depends on the date, and every default date, uses the
sheet's today and never the real clock.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
Each sheet now has its own "today" date, stored on the server, and you can see and change it on the screen. `bin/e2e` passes. I also tested the server directly: a new sheet reads as the real date, a valid change is saved and comes back on reload, and an invalid date like `2024-02-30` is refused with a 400 and nothing is saved.

**What changed:**
- **Stored data:** a new `sheet` table (`src/main/resources/db/migration/V1__sheet.sql`) holds each sheet's today. A sheet that has never been changed has no row, so it reads as the real date and loading a sheet still writes nothing. One effect of this: until someone sets a sheet's date, it moves forward with the real calendar rather than staying on the day the sheet was first used.
- **Server:** `GET /api/sheets/{id}` now returns `today` as well as the id. A new endpoint, `PUT /api/sheets/{id}/today`, changes it, rejecting anything that isn't a real `yyyy-MM-dd` date.
- **Screen:** `features/sheet/today.slot.tsx` shows the date (`sheet-today`) with an input (`sheet-today-input`) and a save button (`sheet-today-save`). A refused change shows `sheet-error`, which clears as soon as the input is edited.

**For future features:** nothing in the app uses a date yet, so there was no existing code to switch over. Anything that needs a date or a default date should use `SheetRepository.today(sheetId)` on the server and `useSheetToday(sheetId)` on the screen, never the real clock.

I didn't add an audit record for changing the date, because the test doesn't expect one and the request doesn't define a format for it.
